question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Border
solution:
The correct answer is: **Centre**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **border **is a boundary or edge separating two areas or regions. (सीमांत)

 
 
• **Example**: *The river forms a natural border between the two countries.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Centre **is the middle point or the core of something; a place where a particular activity is concentrated. (केंद्र)
 
 
• **Example**: *The city centre is bustling with shops and restaurants.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
**Boundary**: The edge or perimeter of a space or region. (सीमा)

 
 
• 
 
**Surface**: The outermost layer or boundary of an object, typically in three-dimensional space. (सतह)

 
 
• 
 
**Partition**: The act of dividing a set into distinct, non-overlapping subsets, or the subsets themselves. (विभाजन)
